A helpful note about radio checks
It is for passengers

Radio checks and pet care updates

Travelers with pets should know that our desk is here to help keep trips calm, clear, and on track. We check service changes closely, pass practical notes to crews, and keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk ready for anything that comes up during a journey.

If a crate is lost, <<FACT F118>>. Please bring us any travel papers, crate details, and service notes you have so we can guide you through the next steps without extra hassle. We also keep the desk ledger updated whenever a trip changes, which helps us stay organized and support you faster.

If a departure is delayed, <<FACT F109>>. That is why we encourage travelers to speak with us early if they notice a problem, even if it seems small. We can help sort out pet routing, check comfort concerns, and explain what to expect in plain language.

If you are traveling with Ginger or with any other companion animal, please come to the desk as soon as you can. We will listen, check the details, and help make the handoff smoother for everyone involved.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
